testCases.title: Verify brand checkboxes are displayed in the sidebar
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
expectedResults: Brand checkboxes are displayed in the sidebar.

testCases.title: Verify selecting brand checkboxes updates product grid
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
Select one or more brand checkboxes.
expectedResults: The product grid updates to show only the selected brands.

testCases.title: Verify combining categories with brand filters updates product grid
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
Select one or more brand checkboxes.
Select one or more category filters.
expectedResults: The product grid updates to show only products matching both selected brands and categories.
